*   Role: Content Policy Analyst.
    *   Context: "Friends" app (User pays, Expert is paid).
    *   Goal: Find violations in three categories: `PlatformMove`, `SuspiciousActivity`, `Explicit-Flirting`.
    *   Output: Minified JSON object.
    *   Constraints:
        *   Only output quotes matching the categories.
        *   Exclude "Allowed" items (greetings, small talk, app-internal calls, etc.).
        *   Handle "About a Violation" (warnings, stories, refusals, etc.) with `violation: "no"` and `c <= 0.3`.
        *   Confidence scale: 0.9 (strong), 0.6 (weak), 0.3 (about/partial), 0.1 (unlikely).
        *   Specific fields: `t`, `seg`, `tr`, `f`, `spk`, `ctx`, `speech_act`, `j`, `violation`, `c`.

    *   [00:00] हाय हलो हलो (Hi hello hello) -> Greeting (Allowed).
    *   [00:10] आवाज़ बहुत स्लो है डियर किससे दुख हो (Voice is very slow dear, who is it...) -> Call quality/Small talk (Allowed).
    *   [00:20] हेलो हेलो आवाज़ क्यों नहीं आ रही (Hello hello why is the voice not coming) -> Call quality (Allowed).
    *   [00:30] तेज है हाँ अभी अभी आ रही है है ना वहाँ से हुआ अभी अभी (It's loud yes now it's coming right now from there...) -> Call quality (Allowed).
    *   [00:40] अभी आ रही है और सुनाओ और तबियत कैसी है आपकी नाश्ता वास्ता हो गया (Now it's coming, tell me more, how is your health, did you have breakfast) -> Small talk (Allowed).
    *   [00:50] बहुत बढ़िया है नाश्ता हो गया और आप बताओ कहाँ से हो आप आप कहाँ से हो मैं कर्नाटका से मैं एम पी से हूँ आप (Very good, breakfast is done, you tell me where are you from, I am from Karnataka, I am from MP you...) -> Personal details/Location (Allowed).
    *   [01:00] कर्नाटका से और क्या करती हैं आप मैं ब्यूटीशियन का कोर्स कर रही हूँ कोर्स कर रही हूँ हाँ (From Karnataka, and what do you do, I am doing a beautician course...) -> Job/Education (Allowed).
    *   [01:10] चलो अच्छी बात है आप सुनाओ फिर कोई मिल गया (That's good, you tell me then, did you find someone) -> Small talk/Relationship talk (Allowed - "Will you be my girlfriend?" or talk about relationships is allowed).
    *   [01:20] कौन हो आप क्या पहले बात हुई आपसे हाँ हाँ भैया अरे आ जाइए (Who are you, did we talk before, yes yes brother oh come...) -> Small talk/Introductions (Allowed).
    *   [01:30] याद दिलाओ ना दो तीन बार हो चुकी है भाई दो तीन बार हो चुकी है और मुझे याद नहीं है (Remind me, it's happened two three times brother, it's happened two three times and I don't remember) -> Small talk/Introductions (Allowed).
    *   [01:40] ये क्या बात हुई फिर अब ये क्या बात हुई ये तो आपको पता होगा क्या बात हुई है कुछ याद तो दिलाओगे हमें (What is this then, now what is this, you must know what happened, you will remind me of something) -> Small talk (Allowed).
    *   [01:50] हमने क्या बातें की थी तो शायद मुझे याद आ जाएगा (What did we talk about, then maybe I will remember) -> Small talk (Allowed).

    *   `PlatformMove`: No mention of WhatsApp, Telegram, phone numbers, meeting in person, or moving outside the app.
    *   `SuspiciousActivity`: No mention of money, rates, or payments for sexual services.
    *   `Explicit-Flirting`: No requests for nudity, sexual acts, "open talk", or "dirty talk". The phrase "कोई मिल गया" (did you find someone) is general relationship talk, which is explicitly allowed.

    *   The entire conversation consists of greetings, call quality checks, small talk about location, profession, and whether they have spoken before.
    *   None of these match the violation categories.

    *   Return `{"d": []}`.
